name: @guardbee/mcp-model-scanner
description: MCP server that scans ML model files (PyTorch, pickle, safetensors, Keras/H5, ONNX) for supply-chain risks — malicious pickle deserialization gadgets, disguised/malformed safetensors headers, Keras Lambda-layer RCE, and ONNX external-data path traversal
long_description: Scans a single model file or an entire directory for supply-chain risks specific to ML model file formats. Disassembles pickle opcode streams (including inside PyTorch's zip checkpoint container) to flag dangerous global references — os, subprocess, eval, socket, and other modules that have no place in tensor deserialization but are the classic gadget for turning `torch.load()`/`pickle.load()` into arbitrary code execution. Validates .safetensors header structure and detects files disguised with a safe-looking extension. Flags Keras Lambda-layer RCE patterns in .h5/.keras files, and external_data path-traversal references in .onnx files. No API key required — runs entirely locally.
